REFERENCES
1. U.S. Department of Transportation, <u>Transportation Noise</u> and Its Control, June 1972.
2. Calspan Report NB-5423-L-1, Acoustic Studies on the Buffalo-Amherst Rapid Transit System, Volume II, March 1974.
3. Institute for Rapid Transit Technical and Operations Committee, Subcommittee on Design Standards, Guidelines and Principles for Design of Rapid Transit Facilities, May 1973.
4. National Cooperative Highway Research Program Report 117, Highway Noise: A Design Guide for Highway Engineers, 1971.
5. U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development; Department Circular 1390.2, Noise Abatement and Control:

Department Policy, Implementation Responsibilities, and Standards, August 1971.
6. T. J. Schultz, <u>HUD Noise Assessment Guidelines Technical</u>
Background, Bolt, Beranek and Newman, Inc., <u>December 1971</u>.
7. U.S. Environmental Protection Agency Publication, Noise from Construction Equipment Operations, Building Equipment and Home Appliances, NTIO 300.1.
8. New York State Department of Environmental Conservation,
Proposed Regulations for the Prevention and Control of
Environmental Noise Pollution, August 1973.
